```{r packages}

library(ggplot2)

```



```{r loadData}

#Load all model outputs
data<-lapply(list.files("model-outputs/sex-evolution",full.names=T)[which(grepl("MSAG",list.files("model-outputs/sex-evolution",full.names=T)))],read.csv)

#Label each run with the viability threshold for zygotes
#Unfortunately I forgot to save this within the data files, so it has to be inferred from filenames
for (i in 1:length(data)) {
  data[[i]]$threshold <- ifelse(i %in% which(grepl(
    "THRESH LO",
    list.files("model-outputs/sex-evolution", full.names = T)
  )),
  "Low Viability Threshold",
  "High Viability Threshold")
}

#Rbind all CSVs together into one dataframe
data<-do.call("rbind",data)


```



```{r analysis}

plotData<-data[data$generation %in% seq(0,30,15), ]

```



```{r plot}

plotData$threshold<-factor(plotData$threshold,levels=c("Low Viability Threshold","High Viability Threshold"))

#Generate a "petri-dish" style figure of the agent populations
p1<-ggplot(data=plotData,
       aes(x=gameteSizeGene1,
           y=runif(nrow(plotData),0,1),
           fill=I("steelblue"),
           size=gameteSizeGene1))+
  geom_point(pch=21,color=I("black"))+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  facet_grid(threshold~generation,scales="free")+
  labs(x="Gamete Size",y="")


#Generate histograms of gamete size
p1hist<-ggplot(data=plotData,
       aes(x=gameteSizeGene1))+
  geom_histogram(fill=I("steelblue"),color=I("black"))+
  facet_grid(threshold~generation,scales="free")+
  labs(x="Gamete Size", y="Frequency")+
  theme_gray(base_size=20)


#Plot gamete size against fusion target in the final generation
p2<-ggplot(data=data[data$generation==max(data$generation) & data$threshold=="High Viability Threshold",],
       aes(y=fusionTargetGene1,
           x=gameteSizeGene1))+
  labs(x="Gamete Size",y="Fusion Target")+
  geom_point()+facet_wrap(~modelLoop,nrow=10,ncol=10)+
  theme(strip.background=element_blank(),strip.text.x=element_blank())

```



```{r save}

ggsave("figures/MSAG Sex Evolution Petri Figure.tiff",p1,width=12,height=3.5,units="in",dpi=300)

ggsave("figures/MSAG Sex Evolution Histogram Figure.tiff",p1hist,width=12,height=8,units="in",dpi=300)

ggsave("figures/MSAG Sex Evolution Fusion Target Figure.tiff",p2,width=12,height=6,dpi=300)

```
